modified: The free-text voice.md became typed fields with limits, read and written only by integrations.reel_studio.voice_profile.
Added what a bridal makeup artist in India needs: city, price band, caption language and code-mix, hashtag bank, emoji she uses, booking contact, brands, logo and logo corner.
choices_from names a tuple in integrations.reel_studio.contracts, so the allowed values have one source.
Field order is the order voice_brief() lists them; brief=false keeps a field out of the brief.
An emoji item is one emoji as igkit.EMOJI_RE reads it; item_max_len 16 code points fits a kiss or a couple with two skin tones (10).

name.label: Name
name.help: Her name or studio name, as clients know it.

services.label: What she does
services.help: One sentence, e.g. bridal and reception makeup, saree draping.

audience.label: Who she talks to
audience.help: Be specific, e.g. brides in Madurai planning a December muhurtham.

tone.label: Tone
tone.help: How she sounds, e.g. warm and chatty, calm, funny.

words_used.label: Words she uses
words_used.help: Words and phrases she really says; the humanizer keeps them.

emoji.label: Emoji she uses
emoji.help: Each emoji she uses, side by side or separated by spaces or commas; the humanizer does not flag these.

hashtag_bank.label: Hashtag bank
hashtag_bank.help: About 15 specific tags, separated by commas or spaces; each reel caption picks a few of them, within the reel cap the caption skill names.

search_terms.label: Search terms
search_terms.help: What brides type into search, e.g. bridal makeup artist Madurai.

cta.label: Her ask
cta.help: The one ask at the end, e.g. DM for bookings.

price_band.label: Price band
price_band.help: Only if she shares it publicly, e.g. bridal from Rs 15k.

proof.label: Proof she can use (never invent more)
proof.help: Real numbers and outcomes she is happy to post, one per line.

off_limits.label: Off limits
off_limits.help: Topics, clients or claims she does not post, one per line.

style_notes.label: Style notes
style_notes.help: Anything else about her look and edits, e.g. soft glam, no heavy contour.

wpm.label: Speaking rate (words per minute)
wpm.help: For voice-over timing; most people speak 150-200.

logo_xid.label: Logo file
logo_xid.help: Store id of her logo image; set by the reel tools.

sample_captions.label: Sample captions
sample_captions.help: Up to three of her own past captions, to match her voice.
